text:
Harper: Heads-up — thinking of a neon-night tapas + speed-boardgames Friday 7pm at Ember Alley. Tiny reservation, casual. Low pressure, BYO drinks. Who wants in?
Sanjay: I’m in if there’s decent vegetarian options.
Molly: count me! i’d prefer seats near the back (less loud).
Tess: in but might be 20 min late. can we do a 7:30 start window?
Harper: sure 7-7:30 window works. Ember Alley supposedly has small plates and a roomy booth.
Diego: i can bring Love Letter and Sushi Go for quick rounds. :game_die:
Harper: /poll "Which vibe do you prefer?" "Tapas + relaxed seating" "Tapas + loud music/dance" "Speed-boardgames (quiet corner)"
bar-bot: Poll created: Which vibe do you prefer? Vote by 3pm today.
Sanjay: voted "Speed-boardgames (quiet corner)". Also gluten-free note for me.
Molly: voted "Tapas + relaxed seating". i'll bring a tiny LED clip for our table if it's too dim.
Tess: voted tapas + relaxed. if split, maybe reserve a booth + ask for moveable chairs to make a games corner.
Harper: good idea. tagging facilities for booth/space request @facilities
facilities: Received: inquiry for Ember Alley — we can request a back booth hold for 7pm for up to 10 ppl. Please confirm final headcount by Thursday noon.
Diego: also, any music bans? i propose no heavy EDM. :sweat_smile:
Molly: agreed, keep it low. also slight request: no microphones.
Harper: noted. i'll put a note when booking. Also, who wants to split the bill or should we do individual tabs?
Sanjay: prefer individual tabs. easier for dietary splits.
Tess: individual tabs please.
Harper: ok individual tabs. i'll make a tentative hold for 8 people and cancel if under 4. will post final at noon Fri.
Diego: bringing tiny prize (a bag of stickers) for 'best bluff' in the speed games. :trophy:
Molly: sold. see y'all Friday!
Harper: awesome — reminder ping at 3pm Friday and i'll drop the booking confirmation. :sparkles:
